normalization: flat ref-tagged lines: '<WORK> <book>.<section>	<text>'; teiHeader stripped; 'arg' divisions excluded; the Life, which has no book division, is referenced 'Vita <section>' (repaired 2026-11-12 from 'Vita ?.<section>')

axn_prior.why: text/Vita.txt reference repair: the Life has no books, and its 430 lines were tagged 'Vita ?.<section>'; they are now 'Vita <section>'. The text is unchanged.

book-end labels repaired in BJ, AJ and CA: 26 last sections had been labelled with the next book's number and carried its heading; relabelled, headings removed to errata. The text of each section is unchanged.

errata.found: The last section of every book of the War (6), the Antiquities (19) and Against Apion (1) was labelled with the next book's number (e.g. 'BJ 2.673' for War 1.673), and carried the next book's heading at its end. A search for a book's last section found nothing; a search for '2.673' found Book I.
errata.cause: Book-boundary handling in normalization: the milestone of each book's last section was read after the next book's div had opened.
errata.repair: Each line relabelled with its own book; the heading removed from the line and kept here. The text of the sections is unchanged.
